description_en: Queries the information about an AI task by task ID
description_zh: 指定AI任务ID，获取AI任务的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun ros get-ai-task --task-id t-asasas00000 --output-option Disabled --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAITask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the TaskOutput parameter. The TaskOutput parameter specifies the outputs of the AI task. Valid values:

Enabled
Disabled (default)

The value of TaskOutput may be excessively long. If you do not require the outputs of the task, we recommend that you set OutputOption to Disabled to improve the response speed of the API operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回TaskOutput参数（任务的输出）。取值：  

Enabled：返回TaskOutput参数。  

Disabled（默认值）：不返回TaskOutput参数。  
TaskOutput输出较长。如果不需要获取Outputs信息，建议您将OutputOption指定为Disabled，提高接口响应速度
parameters.name: output_option

Message.example: You are not authorized to complete this action.
